title: crepidium mindanaense
intro: Crepidium mindanaense, commonly known as Mindanao crepidium or the orchid of the mountains, is a species of orchid native to the Philippines. This terrestrial orchid has been found to have potential health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels and improve digestion, due to its high content of flavonoids and other bioactive compounds. The therapeutic actions of Crepidium mindanaense include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its potential in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
